purpose: Record who has scientifically reviewed each frozen decision, and at what level of independence. Held separately from config/stage1_search_config.json because that file's checksum is embedded in all ten archived run summaries: editing it to correct a reviewer name would invalidate every pinned search and force a re-run of the entire Stage 1 acquisition.

supersedes.note: That value was a placeholder present when the searches executed. It is superseded by this record and must not be read as a reviewer identity. The frozen file itself is deliberately left unchanged so the pinned run checksums remain valid.

stage1_search_strategy.scope_reviewed: Frozen geographic domain, biological and measurement terms, per-source strategies, screening rules, catalogue-identity rules, the sixteen-dataset known-item benchmark set, and the access and licence policy.
stage1_search_strategy.independence_statement: The designer and the reviewer are not independent parties, so STAGED_WORK_PLAN.md Stage 1 action 2 — 'have a second scientific reviewer check exclusions and ambiguous query choices' — is NOT satisfied by this record. It is recorded as reviewed, not as independently reviewed, and every reported result must carry that distinction.

independent_review.plan: An independent second scientific reviewer is to be identified once preliminary results exist and the scope of what needs reviewing is concrete.
independent_review.rationale_for_deferral: Principal-investigator decision, 2026-08-08: a reviewer is easier to recruit and brief against concrete results than against a search strategy alone.
independent_review.risk_if_not_completed: Exclusion and query decisions taken by a single party would enter the confirmatory analysis unchecked. The exclusions most in need of a second reader are the dataset-metadata screen, which excludes 18,503 catalogue rows on one reason code, and the access-driven scope reductions in config/access_and_licence_policy.json.
